test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: By selling an article for ₹20, a dealer makes a profit of 20%. By how much should he increase his selling price (in ₹, rounded off to two decimal place) so as to make a profit of 30%?
solution:
**Given:**

Selling price (SP) = ₹20

Profit percentage (P%) = 20%

Desired profit percentage (P%) = 30%

**Formula used:**

Cost price (CP) = SP ÷ (1 + Profit Percentage ÷ 100)

New SP = CP × (1 + Desired Profit Percentage ÷ 100)
